paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.27% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.09%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.96%). Brent crude changed +0.03% to 98.32. Gold changed -0.94% to 4,074.8999. Bitcoin changed +0.18% to 75,883.9766. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.859%, a relative move of +0.45%. Among the firms tracked, Franklin Templeton (+4.72%) and Deutsche Bank (-4.34%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Monzo explores fundraising at £7.5bn valuation as private equity talks stall (FT Markets). Lender had shifted focus to talks with buyout groups after failing to clinch a £10bn takeover by Brazilian fintech Nubank Deals and capital markets: Anthropic to press ahead with IPO targeting $1.5tn valuation (FT Markets). Claude maker intends to list before Thanksgiving despite brutal tech rout Central banks and macro: Blowout October payrolls data sets up Federal Reserve December rate rise (FT World). Non-farm payrolls beat expectations by 100,000 jobs in October Geopolitics and trade: Qatar’s emir holds call with Trump as mediators push for deal to end Iran war (FT World). Leaders speak days after voters rebuke US president over Iran war and high fuel prices Geopolitics and trade: Iran celebrates Trump’s election defeat as mediators push for deal to end war (FT Home). Regional negotiators, led by Qatar, have stepped up efforts to broker an interim agreement between Washington and Tehran
